Article 9.1: Using Your FFN Dashboard

Warren's summary

The FFN dashboard at fundedfuturesnetwork.com shows your account overview, account balance with unrealized P&L, trailing drawdown floor, current profit, and various performance metrics including today's P&L, best and worst day P&L, win rate, and eligibility to withdraw. The Account Reporting section displays a checklist of active rules like max drawdown and contracts, total commissions paid, consistency percentage, and a daily account balance chart tracking balance versus drawdown over time. The dashboard updates periodically throughout the day with a Last Updated timestamp shown on the Account Reporting screen. You can access your trading platform by clicking Preferred Platforms to select Rithmic or Nexus Connect, or use the Onyx login link; for other platforms you must download them and login after signing Rithmic documents.

Dashboard Overview

The FFN dashboard is accessible at fundedfuturesnetwork.com. After logging in, you will see:

Dashboard: main account overview
Add Account: purchase or add a new account
Preferred Platforms: link to your trading platform (Rithmic or Nexus Connect)
Account Reporting Screen

The Account Reporting section shows:

Dashboard Field	What It Shows
Account Balance	Your current account balance including open unrealized P&L
Trailing Drawdown	The current drawdown floor: your account cannot go below this
Current Profit	Net profit above starting balance
Targets & Goals	Checklist of active rules (max drawdown, contracts, trading hours)
Today's P&L	Net profit or loss for the current trading session
Best Day P&L	Your best single-day net profit ever on this account
Total Commissions	Cumulative commission costs charged by the broker
Worst Day P&L	Your worst single-day net result on this account
Eligible to Withdraw	The dollar amount you are currently eligible to withdraw
Consistency %	Your current consistency percentage relative to your best day
Win/Loss	Win rate and breakdown of total trades
Daily Account Balance Chart	Visual chart of balance vs. drawdown over time
Cash on Hand	Previous trading day's end of day account balance
Trader Tools

The dashboard also provides quick links to:

Financial News Calendar (powered by Financial Juice: use to identify T1 events)
FFN YouTube Channel
Trading Journal
Personal Broker Account setup
Sign Rithmic Documents
Risk Manager Request form
Discord Link

Q: How current is the dashboard data?

A: The dashboard updates periodically throughout the day. Use the 'Last Updated' timestamp shown on the Account Reporting screen to see when data was last refreshed.

Q: How do I access my trading platform from the dashboard?

A: Click Preferred platforms and select the platform you would like to use. If you use Onyx, there is a link on the Onyx section that will open the login page. For any other platforms, you must download them on to your computer and login after you sign the Rithmic documents.
